request.subject: PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:RAIDER

layers.text: Change only the colours: the red feather crest becomes a bright orange feather crest, colour #fe6d00; the red collar is removed, leaving bare hide; the blue hide becomes deep blue, colour #205794 with #164271 shadows, with two thick bright orange stripes on the back of the neck; the throat and teeth stay cream. Nothing red is left. Do not redraw anything. Keep the head, eye, grin, claw, pose, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
